title: Professional presentation
description: Listen to an advanced presentation excerpt and identify key language.
audioText: Let me outline the three key points. Rarely have we seen such a compelling case for strategic change.

items.prompt: What does the speaker want to do first?
items.promptIt: Cosa vuole fare per primo il parlante?
items.transcript: Let me outline the three key points.

items.prompt: How is the case for change described?
items.promptIt: Come viene descritto il caso per il cambiamento?
items.transcript: Rarely have we seen such a compelling case for strategic change.

items.prompt: Complete: Let me ____ the three key points.
items.promptIt: Completa: Let me ____ the three key points.
items.transcript: Let me outline the three key points.
items.explanation: Outline means to present the structure of your talk.
